modal.title: Record Overpayment
modal.confirmBody: This will create a negative bank transfer and fund payment group to offset the overpayment.
modal.cancelBody: This will permanently cancel the refund and revert the source procedure to its previous status.

noAccountTooltip: A bank account must be created before recording a refund.

error.refundDate: Refund date is required and must not be in the future.

errors.source_not_refundable: This procedure is not eligible for a refund.
errors.transfer_type_rejected: This payment method is not accepted for refunds.
errors.source_has_no_fund: The source procedure has no associated fund.
errors.refund_group_protected: This payment group belongs to a refund and can only be removed by cancelling the refund.
errors.refund_record_not_found: No overpayment record found for this procedure.
